source.text:
November 7, 2019




Notice is given under Section 22.2(3) of the Forest and Range Practices Act the Bucklin
Forest Service Road is hereby closed effective immediately beyond 0.8 km in the vicinity of
Second Canyon Creek until further notice.
Forest and Range Practices Act

Non-industrial use of a road

  22.2  (1) Subject to subsections (2) to (4) and to regulations respecting roads made under the

  Industrial Roads Act, a road that is

  (a) a forest service road, or

  (b) constructed or maintained by the holder of a road permit or a woodlot

  licence

  may be used by any person, other than a person referred to in section 22.1, without charge.

  (2) The

  (a) district manager, for a forest service road, or

  (b) holder of a road permit or a woodlot licence, for a road under the permit or

  licence,

  may take action under subsection (3) if

  (c) use of the road under subsection (1) would likely

  (i) cause significant damage to the road,

  (ii) cause significant sediment delivery, or

  (iii) endanger property, public health or public safety, or

  (d) the presence on the road of a vehicle or animal would likely cause damage

  to the road or environment or endanger life or property.

  (3) In the circumstances described in subsection (2),

  (a) the district manager, for a forest service road, may

  (i) close the road or restrict its use, or

  (ii) remove a vehicle or an animal from the road at the expense of the
  owner of the vehicle or animal, and

  (b) the holder of a road permit or a woodlot licence, for a road under the

  permit or licence,

  (i) with the prior consent of the minister, may close the road or restrict

  its use, or

  (ii) may remove a vehicle or an animal from the road at the expense of

  the owner of the vehicle or animal.




This action is in response to the current structure conditions for Structure CK-2231
identified in the last bridge inspection dated November 6, 2019 which pose a significant
threat to workers safety.
The current road closure may change subject to replacement of the bridge guardrail.




Thank- you for your cooperation during this time.
  Digitally signed by
  Mike Peters
  Date: 2019.11.08
  10:34:25 -08'00'
Mike Peters
District Manager
Chilliwack Natural Resource District
